text:
May I ask you where you live/ planning to live? How do you feel to be there from the community and your surroundings? Ever felt or meet racism?

My partners mother was saying the same as your in-laws, she told him that I had to convert and that our future kids can not live with 2 religions, they need to grow up with Only one AND on top of that she said that our kids wont be able and be accepted to go to jewish kindergartens and schools. (She really tried to scare my partner who believed in her) She was wrong big time!

He is from Haifa, we lived there for about 5 years, it was great there, with wonderful people and no racism at all! 

Now we live in Tirat Karmel since 5 years (unfortunately we had to move) (just on the border to Haifa)…and its a bit different here, a challenging city for other reasons….the ashkenazi jews and christians are great here (they moved here from other citys mainly from Haifa, no judgements at all, because there are plenty half/ half’s here as well.

We had some few judgments here from the mizrahi ”younger” mums, never from their husbands, their husbands are great and never discriminated me or our kids, even thoe their wife’s tried indirectly, so I understood that their primary problem is not that I am not a jew, its about jealousy, and secondly that they are racists to non jews and more directly to muslims and arabs (as they said themselves) 

So you will maybe face something similar but you will just have to learn how to answer these and treat them like air, I did and it helped, they started to want to be my friend and I ignored their friendships…

But also we wont stay here in this city for long, we want to live in a more liberal and sophisticated city.

Otherwise my 7 year old have never faced anything bad neither from the kindergartens nor from the school.

Dont do anything against your fully will…follow your hart…

Best of Luck! 🍀💚
